scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Score only independent final scientific answers to the public question. Each outcome earns its full fixed weight or zero; only explicitly reviewable unresolved scientific conflicts may receive need_review, which earns no points and is not success. Fully supported physically equivalent explanations pass directly. Missing calculations, unsupported guesses, wrong identity/state/reference/environment/units and hard-window failures fail, never need_review. Genuine native outputs and reproducible analyses must support each claim; supplied observations and PR source targets are not newly computed results. Structures, convergence, frequencies and state correspondence establish claim validity and earn no independent points. Evidence requirements are proportional to the particular claim, with no fixed workflow, software, root count or control grid. AR selects its method independently. PR addresses its disclosed author baseline or a scientifically justified comparable substitute, without separate route-completion points. No historical PASS certifies the revised V3 rubric.

Actual neighboring isoxazole and methoxyphenyl ring geometry supports a nearly parallel, laterally offset packing contact, with explicit rings and symmetry; equivalent shape-index/curvedness evidence can corroborate it. Distinguish plane orientation and lateral slip from simply asserting pi stacking on the basis of aromaticity.

reference_qualification.json.accepted_limitations: Historical strict acceptance is observed-crystal contact/surface interpretation, not lattice energies or biomedical effects. CE25.8/OCC is a documented supported substitute for17.5, not identical software. SourceE/Z, centroid/projection anddnorm range/unit conflicts remain. Contact fraction and shape-index support packing geometry but do not quantify interaction stabilization; source claims of energy causation are bounded accordingly. No monomer HOMO–LUMO or docking work substitutes for crystal evidence. AR centroid/projection credit requires geometry from its supplied CIF, never criticism of an inaccessible article label. Surface-area leaves remain observables specific to the Hirshfeld representation: energetic alternatives can support geometric/synthesis leaves but cannot substitute energy fractions for area. Cross-representation weight calibration remains a disclosed residual policy risk.
reference_qualification.json.tolerance_basis: Each source HSA fraction uses inclusive±0.5percentage point, a common small class reflecting one-decimal source reporting, finite mesh quadrature and explicitly matchedH normalization/stockholder definition. Actual fine-grid residuals are all<0.05; the window was not fitted to the largest residual and remains much smaller than separations among main contact classes. It does not admit a different crystal or an unnormalized count. No numerical window is imposed around mislabeled3.3883Å; the geometry conflict is semantic and requires recomputing both physical definitions. Source0.0006Å is not borrowed as uncertainty for a different distance. Conditional propagated marginalESDs do not supply full-covariance confidence intervals.
